decisions.question: Accent joins sounds
decisions.resolution: The local noun is implicit. §68 explains how accent brings several articulated sounds together into the unity of a word.

decisions.question: Historical and physiological explanation
decisions.resolution: §47 explains why similarity of sound cannot decide the distinction. Keep its wording broad enough to leave open the precise historical process.

decisions.question: Object and presentation
decisions.resolution: Presentation names what becomes present in thought, distinct from the object as object. The object is what a person apprehends.

decisions.question: A language-specific view
decisions.resolution: The view comes from the ways a language makes concepts available. §86 preserves differences among individuals who share a language.

decisions.question: Matter and form of the word
decisions.resolution: This label belongs to the threefold way of bringing objects before the soul. The contrasting form concerns cooperation of faculties. Form denotes the cooperation of faculties in the same three respects. The definition is local to the word.

decisions.question: Direction of derivation
decisions.resolution: The order is confirmed on p. 421. The converse in §93 makes a reversal plausible. Preserve the print and signal the difference at both anchors in the records.

decisions.question: A word’s way of designating a concept
decisions.resolution: This is the word-specific designation through a selected conceptual aspect. §99 asks separately whether speakers still feel the motivation and whether an investigator can recover it.

decisions.question: Dwelling in a sequence of presentations
decisions.resolution: The print reads Weile. §102:s5 and the deleted passage under §101 contrast dwelling with movement. §102:s7 separately concerns breaks and pauses.

decisions.question: The bearer of the resonance
decisions.resolution: Keep the straightforward attachment of the genitive to Geist. A preposed genitive with Gehalt gives another plausible reading, in which the substance held in the language resounds to a human mind.

decisions.question: First element in a derived verb
decisions.resolution: Verba supplies the closest stated class. The parallel with the original stem also permits original stem as the first constituent.

decisions.question: Historical classifier for possession
decisions.resolution: The label is glossed through the factual relation of possession mentioned later. No example in §122 establishes its grammatical realization.

decisions.question: Scope of feeling
decisions.resolution: This is the author’s broader stipulated sense, inclusive of an intellectual orientation operating without clear consciousness.

decisions.question: Uncertain antecedent in the closing line
decisions.resolution: The printed pronoun is masculine singular and does not agree with the earlier pronoun for the changes. The argument from the material part to a fuller study supports including the changes.
